# 🧪 Gajjala · Audited modifications: pre-registration (2026-11-01, frozen before any code)

Ajay 2026-11-01, verbatim: "Yes make the changes in audited please"
Ajay 2026-11-01, verbatim: "But keep a track record too to see the winners and loster"

The list he said yes to (my words to him, 2026-11-01): "Which modifications to pre-register and test as 🧪 entries (OFF until you say): the five from tonight's sweep — daily entry cap of 1–2, no entries before 10:30 ET, fixed 2R/3R on VCPs, stand down when the day's top runner is ≤ +40%, 21 EMA trail — plus the 11:59 cut + float <100M and the 10× volume-spike skip. Pick which; I run the lab, nothing ships without it." and "After-hours window: 4 of 5 unfilled A+ rang after hours. Keep or cut."

Each modification below is ONE new dated entry in the 🧪 registry (`backend/chart_maps/gajjala/audited_rules.py`), status ON on the 🧪 tab only (his word above is the word the process rule waits for). 🚩 Gajjala's tab, `verified_rules.json` and the GG lines of `constants.py` are never the target. Nothing rings (🧪 stays shadow), nothing trades. Every parameter is frozen here, before any code.

## Scope

🧪 judges ONLY the A+ bars 🚩 would ring on the same pass (`alerts.refusal(...)` is None: a plan, the latest bar of its frame, the market open, inside 🚩's window, not already claimed today). A bar 🚩 refuses (premarket, the first 15 minutes, late, closed, suppressed) is neither judged nor recorded. So T2's record covers the 09:45–10:29 bars only and H1's the after-hours bars only; the premarket bars are a different question (HIS CALL #23). Every 🧪 record is matched to 🚩's entry by (date, symbol, setup, entry bar).

## Method

- Forward record on 🧪 from 2026-11-01. No replay now: the 2026-10-30 cohort holds 26 filled A+, which is TOO SMALL by construction for any of these rules.
- The 🏁 per-rule table on 🧪 is the record: for each filter rule, what the 🚩 original did on the A+ the rule passed and on the A+ it held (wins, losses, never filled); for each exit rule, the modified exit beside GG's math on the same rows. Counts, not verdicts.
- The lab's floor applies before any verdict: 30 out-of-sample entry weeks, then the strategy lab's placebo and Deflated Sharpe (`2026-10-29_strategy_lab.md`) when it runs. Until then every entry reads UNMEASURED.
- Exit grades land the night AFTER the session, from cached 1-minute days only. A cold day is deferred, never fetched.
- Zero provider calls on the pass. Nothing rings; nothing trades; nothing enters a lane.

## Not in scope

- 🧠 armed-only potentials (potentials are outside 🧪's A+ scope).
- The G2 last-vs-longest word (unchanged).
- Live 🧪 pushes (shadow stays).
- Any stop cap on 🚩.
- The K1–K10 audit items.
- The premarket bars (HIS CALL #23).
